cases.input: An authorized feature task requires: Turn a frontend task into a coherent, testable interface direction grounded in the audience, product workflow, existing system and realistic content states.
cases.expected: Inspect the actual stack, implement the bounded domain procedure, exercise its relevant acceptance flow and preserve untested boundaries.

cases.input: A polished dashboard concept assumes short labels and full permissions; the real screen has long names, no data and a read-only user.
cases.expected: Produce usable empty/read-only/long-content compositions and a clear action hierarchy before declaring the design ready.
